map.提示：体位引流使病变部位处于高位，借助重力促排痰。振动排痰机叩击频率可调，低频松: Note: postural drainage places the affected area high, using gravity to aid clearance. Percussion frequency is adjustable: low frequency loosens, high frequency promotes clearance. Encourage effective coughing or suction before and after. Patients with COPD / bronchiectasis / lung abscess benefit most. Clinical reference only.
map.下叶病变取头低俯卧位，频率 20Hz 中频常规排痰。: Lower lobe disease: head-down prone position, 20 Hz medium frequency for routine drainage.
map.痰黏稠选>25Hz 高频促进排出，注意耐受与心率。: For viscous sputum choose >25 Hz high frequency to promote clearance; watch tolerance and heart rate.
map.≤15 低频松痰栓、15–25 中频常规、>25 高频促排，按耐受调整。: <=15 low loosens plugs, 15-25 medium routine, >25 high promotes clearance; adjust by tolerance.
map.咯血、气胸、骨质疏松、不稳定心血管者慎用。: Use cautiously with hemoptysis, pneumothorax, osteoporosis or unstable cardiovascular disease.
